input.quote: 10.8 Headings; Counterparts. The section headings in this Agreement are for reference purposes only and shall not define, limit or affect the meaning or interpretation of this Agreement.
input.rationale: No insurance provision exists anywhere in the Agreement: searches for "insurance", "insur/coverage/certificate", and "liability" return only the no-joint-venture language, and the General Provisions run (Sections 10.1–10.8) ends with Headings/Counterparts. HDI designs, hosts and operates the Site on its own server and has access to our Content, user information and data (Section 8.1), so it is a services/hosting vendor processing Customer Data and the rule applies; this is walk-away territory absent any coverage. We inserted a short Section 10.9 at the preferred level covering CGL USD 1M per occurrence / USD 2M aggregate, E&O USD 2M, cyber and privacy USD 5M where HDI processes any data belonging to, supplied by or processed for the Company, statutory workers' compensation, and certificates on request, without adding expense, survival or procedural extras.

proposal.summary: Insert an insurance clause in Section 10 (General Provisions) requiring HDI to carry CGL, E&O, cyber/privacy and workers' compensation coverage and to furnish certificates on request.
proposal.comment: [Playbook] The Agreement has no insurance provision even though HDI hosts the Site and processes our user and order data, so we added our standard coverage requirements (CGL USD 1M/2M, E&O USD 2M, cyber USD 5M, statutory workers' compensation, certificates on request). If helpful, we can fall back to E&O of USD 1,000,000 and cyber of USD 2,000,000.

ops.text: Insurance. HDI shall maintain throughout the term of this Agreement: (a) commercial general liability insurance of not less than USD 1,000,000 per occurrence and USD 2,000,000 in the aggregate; (b) professional liability (errors and omissions) insurance of not less than USD 2,000,000; (c) where HDI processes any data belonging to, supplied by, or processed for the Company, cyber and privacy liability insurance of not less than USD 5,000,000; and (d) workers' compensation insurance as required by law. HDI shall provide certificates of insurance to the Company on request.

mappings.element: Commercial general liability coverage is at least USD 1,000,000 per occurrence.
Commercial general liability coverage is at least USD 2,000,000 in the aggregate.
Professional errors and omissions coverage is at least USD 2,000,000.
If Vendor processes Customer Data, cyber and privacy coverage is at least USD 5,000,000.
Vendor maintains workers' compensation coverage as required by law.
Vendor provides certificates of insurance on request.
